description: A condition in which the skin and whites of the eyes turn yellow.
causes: Excess bilirubin in the blood, often due to liver disease or bile duct obstruction.
prevention: Maintain liver health and get vaccinated for hepatitis.
complications: Brain damage (in newborns) and liver failure.
